Ava (docs): Heads-up: I'm working through the structured-output v2 migration section and found a few subtle mismatches between the prose, the JSON schema example, and the TypeScript snippets. CI didn't blow up yet but SDK tests caught one failing example. Can we align before the next release?
Diego (eng): Which example? I skimmed earlier and saw the callback/handler examples still use the old `onComplete` shape. Runtime switched to `callbacks: [{ id, kind, handler }]` last month.
Mina (devex): Yep that broke our JS snippet in the integration test. Quick patch should be fine. Can someone paste the canonical callback shape we should show?
Rafi (eng-ml): Canonical callback envelope per the runtime RFC: `{ "callbacks": [{ "id": "cb_01", "kind": "webhook", "handler": { "url": "https://...", "method": "POST" } }] }`. Also note that `result` field moved under `output` for v2: `output.result` required when `status`=="success".
Ava (docs): Great — I'll update the JSON schema block to show `output` with required `result` and `callbacks` as an array of objects. Should we add a guardrail about not relying on callback ordering?
Diego (eng): Please do. Also add a line: "Use callback.id as the stable reference for retries; do not infer identity from array index." Ops will appreciate that.
Mina (devex): I'll change the JS/TS snippets. Proposed JS snippet for docs: 
```js
const resp = await client.invoke({
  operation: { name: 'render.pdf', args: { url } },
  callbacks: [{ id: 'cb_01', kind: 'webhook', handler: { url: 'https://hooks.example/cb', method: 'POST' } }]
});
// resp.status === 'success'
// resp.output.result -> { url: 'https://cdn.example/xyz.pdf' }
```
Diego (eng): Two small nitpicks: 1) SDK surface in TS uses `invokeOperation` for v2; change `client.invoke` -> `client.invokeOperation`. 2) In the schema example, show `output.result` typed as nullable only when `status` == 'error'.
Rafi (eng-ml): And add the guardrail: "Treat `error` as canonical failure; do not attempt to parse partial `output.result` on failure responses."
Ava (docs): Will do. Also CI link-check flagged a broken in-page anchor linking to `#callback-guidelines` from the migration checklist. The heading was renamed to "Callbacks and delivery guardrails" so generator expects `#callbacks-and-delivery-guardrails`.
docs-bot: link-check(https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/structured-output#callback-guidelines) -> 404. Suggest: #callbacks-and-delivery-guardrails
Mina (devex): Adding a short Rust snippet for parity in the new examples too. Proposed Rust example: 
```rust
let req = InvokeRequest::new_operation("render.pdf").with_callback(Callback::webhook("cb_01", "https://hooks.example/cb"));
let res = client.invoke_operation(req).await?;
// res.output.result.id exists when res.status == Status::Success
```
Diego (eng): Nice. Minor: prefer `InvokeOperationRequest` naming in our Rust SDK examples.
Ava (docs): I'll incorporate all naming fixes, the schema change (output.result required on success), guardrail bullets (callback id + ordering + treat error as canonical), and the anchor fix. I'll open a small PR and drop the link here.
Mina (devex): I'll also add a one-line Jest snippet in the docs test suite asserting `expect(resp.output.result).toBeDefined()` so this doesn't regress silently.
Rafi (eng-ml): Quick wording suggestion for the guardrail: "Do not rely on callback array ordering; use callback.id for idempotency and retries."
Ava (docs): Good phrasing, using it. Opening PR now.
Ava (docs): PR #1524: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1524 - includes snippets, schema updates, guardrails, and anchor fix. Requesting reviews from @Diego and @Rafi.
Diego (eng): Reviewing now. Tiny nit on TS snippet — rename `handler.method` -> `handler.http_method` to match SDK.
Mina (devex): Linting caught a trailing comma in the JSON schema block, fixing locally.
docs-bot: PR #1524  ci/linkcheck  pending
Rafi (eng-ml): LGTM after the handler naming tweak. Also consider a short note in the migration checklist reminding clients to rotate webhook URLs and verify signatures after migration — we've seen forgotten webhooks in the past.
Ava (docs): Added a sentence in the migration checklist about rotating URLs and checking signatures. Force-pushed.
docs-bot: PR #1524  ci/linkcheck  passed
Diego (eng): Merged. :shipit:
Ava (docs): Thanks all! I'll run a grep across the site for any lingering `onComplete`/`result` instances and open follow-ups. If you see other mismatches in SDK naming, drop them here and I'll batch them into an audit PR.
Mina (devex): Filing an audit ticket now to sync examples across languages. :clipboard:
